What we do

Auto Glass Services

Windscreen Replacers only does auto glass. Cars and trucks, windscreens and windows, seals and wipers: that is the whole business, and every service below comes to the vehicle.

  • Every service is mobile
  • Open 24 hours, 7 days
  • Cars, utes, vans and trucks
  • Sydney and New South Wales

Get a quote today

Request a Quote 0423 018 888

Services

Everything we fit and repair

We carry the glass, the tools and the adhesive to you. Each page below covers what the job involves, what moves the price and what to expect on the day.

  • 01Windscreen replacementFull front windscreen replacement for passenger cars, SUVs, utes and vans, matched to your exact make, model and build.
  • 02Windscreen chip and crack repairSmall chips and short cracks filled and sealed before they spread, usually far cheaper than a replacement.
  • 03Truck windscreen replacementHeavy vehicle glass fitted at your depot, yard or roadside, with downtime kept as short as we can make it.
  • 04Fleet and commercial glassMulti-vehicle scheduling and account work for operators who measure the cost in downtime, not glass.
  • 05Rear window replacementRear glass replaced and the shattered fragments cleared out properly, with demister connections checked.
  • 06Car side window replacementDoor, quarter and vent glass replaced, with the correct tint and thickness for your vehicle.
  • 07Windscreen seal replacementPerished seals that leak or whistle, and pinch-weld rust dealt with properly rather than covered up.
  • 08Wiper blade replacementBlades matched to the vehicle and fitted on site while we are already there.

How we work

One quote, given before the work starts

You tell us the make, model and build year and what is damaged. We confirm the exact glass your vehicle takes and quote on that, not on an average. If something changes when we see the vehicle, we tell you before we touch it, not afterwards.

If the damage turns out to be repairable, we will say so. A chip caught early is a much cheaper job than a replacement, and we would rather do the small job well.

Request a Quote 0423 018 888

Questions

Service questions

Is every service mobile?

Yes. We bring the glass, the adhesive and the tools to the vehicle: at home, at work, or roadside if that is where the car has stopped.

Do you work on trucks as well as cars?

Yes. Heavy vehicle glass is fitted at depots, yards and roadside, and we work with fleet operators across NSW. See truck windscreen replacement.

What areas do you cover?

Sydney and New South Wales. The service area page lists every area with its own page.

Get moving again

Not sure which service you need?

Send us a photo of the damage and we will tell you which job you are actually looking at.
